source_method: Public SEC submissions metadata and complete-envelope original filings from a no-key public archive mirror. Hash the received representation and preserve source links. Original press ranges, filing clocks, intervening written disclosures and dated cover identities are reviewed before market checks.
held_clock_rule: Calculate the scheduled session from SEC accepted time. Availability proxy is acceptance plus two minutes, floored at the filing-date start in New York. Exclude after 17:30 ET, regular-hours ambiguity, or availability at/after scheduled open minus 15 minutes. This proxy does not prove actual first-public or receipt time.
scope_limit: Manual qualification is a lower bound. Unconfirmed rows leave room for additional research. The held candidates focus on the already qualified names and verified new pairs. The original July 2025 to September 2026 held windows apply by reaction date.
interim_rule: Reviewed intervening SEC items as guidance-change leads. Retain source binding and known written numeric reaffirmations. Separate catalyst, scope-change and unresolved identity rows remain outside this opening check.
